remarks: An Amazing Opportunity to see a Designer Showcase home totally transformed by the current owners. Treat yourself and treat your clients. Come preview a chic sophisticated home with an outstanding floor plan, spacious rooms, high ceilings and the finest finishes. Enjoy an elevated lifestyle with rooms for every occasion. The Living Room with beautiful millwork is a special haven for entertaining. The open floor plan of the Family Room with fireplace opening to a gourmets dream Kitchen is undisputably perfect. Working from home is not a challenge with several sun filled Offices. Join friends & family in the Great Room for games, billiards, and conversations. Or watch serious sports, movies and more in the lower level Media Room Beautifully sited and beautifully landscaped on over an acre, you are minutes from shopping, parks, trains and schools.
